knowledge_window_rule: Fixed retrospective evidence window ending 30 calendar days after the world-time cutoff.
later_observation_policy: Observations after the world-time cutoff are admissible only as evidence about product identity or state valid on or before 2026-09-24; post-cutoff world-state changes must not be projected backward into this analysis universe.
boundary: This manifest freezes the Release-A A2 analytical universe and evidence cutoffs. It does not establish global completeness, unseen-population size, market share, comparative effectiveness, S2 publication authority, or v4.2 assessment effect.
